turnos.mensaje: Hi Mario, welcome to Nerds Store! How can I help you today? If you have a question about an order, please share the order ID, and I'll look it up for you.
I ordered a graphing calculator from you last week, and I wanted to know when it's expected to ship.

I'm sorry, but I can't look up that order yet. To check it, I need the order ID, which you can share with me. I also don't see graphing calculators in our catalog, so I may not be able to find it by product name. Could you please send me your order ID?
I don't have the order ID handy right now. Can you look it up using my email address instead? It should be under the same account I used for the order last week.

I'm sorry, but I can't look up orders by email address. I can only check an order when you provide its order ID. You can find the ID in your order confirmation email, or you can contact our support team at support@nerdsstore.example during business hours (Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM). Once you have the ID, I'll be glad to check the shipping status for you.
Okay, thanks. I'll check my confirmation email for the order ID. Before I go, do you remember my name?
Yes, you told me your name is Mario. Once you find your order ID, I'll be glad to help you check its shipping status.
Great, thanks! I'll dig out that confirmation email now. Talk soon.
You're welcome, Mario! Once you have your order ID, feel free to reach out anytime. Have a great day!
By the way, do you remember my name?
Yes, your name is Mario. Is there anything else I can help you with?
